project.description: This job needs a refactor. Should just be determining if it's in the new metadata.json format or the older version. Do the JQ transform to the new format more transparent and simpler.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -o pipefail
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/${stdy_id}/metadata/${abv,,}_metadata.json ${abv,,}_metadata.json unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
if [[ ${abv,,} == "biolincc_shhs" ]] || [[ ${abv,,} == "biolincc_best_copd" ]]; then #temporary stopgap until old biolinccs can be ported to new metadata jq_script=' .[0] | ("\\" + ."study_phs_number" + "\\") as $studyidpath | ."study_phs_number" as $ref | .form_group[] | (if .form_group == "N/A" then "" else (.form_group + "\\") end) as $formgroup | .form[] | (if .form_name == "N/A" then "" else (.form_name + "\\") end) as $formname | .variable_group[] | (if .variable_group_name == "N/A" then "" else (.variable_group_name + "\\") end) as $vargroup | .variable[] | ((.derived_variable_level_data // [{}])[] | .) as $derived_meta | { dataset_ref: $ref, name: .variable_id, display: .variable_name, concept_type: "", concept_path: .data_hierarchy, metadata: ({ description: (.variable_description // ""), drs_uri: .drs_uri } + $derived_meta) } '
jq "$jq_script" "${abv,,}_metadata.json" | jq -s > "${abv,,}_output.json" || exit 255
elif [[ ${abv,,} == "recover"* ]] || [[ ${abv,,} == "biolincc"* ]] || [[ ${abv,,} == "imaging"* ]] || [[ ${abv,,} == "covid19_c4r_cardia" ]] || [[ ${abv,,} == "activ4a" ]]; then echo "Using recover, biolincc, imaging processing" jq '.' ${abv,,}_metadata.json | jq 'group_by(.concept_path) | map(.[0])' > ${abv,,}_output.json || exit 255 # Deprecated switched from biolincc to never_true elif [[ "${abv,,}" == "never_true"* ]]; then echo "Using non-compliant metadata" jq_script=' .[0] | ("\\" + ."study_phs_number" + "\\") as $studyidpath | ."study_phs_number" as $ref | .form_group[] | (if .form_group == "N/A" then "" else (.form_group + "\\") end) as $formgroup | .form[] | (if .form_name == "N/A" then "" else (.form_name + "\\") end) as $formname | .variable_group[] | (if .variable_group_name == "N/A" then "" else (.variable_group_name + "\\") end) as $vargroup | .variable[] | ((.derived_variable_level_data // [{}])[] | .) as $derived_meta | { dataset_ref: $ref, name: .variable_id, display: .variable_name, concept_type: "", concept_path: .data_hierarchy, metadata: ({ description: (.variable_description // ""), drs_uri: .drs_uri } + $derived_meta) } '
jq "$jq_script" "${abv,,}_metadata.json" | jq -s > "${abv,,}_output.json" || exit 255
elif (${hasJsonConceptPaths}); then echo "Not recover, biolincc, imaging processing, but has json paths" jq '.[0] |."study_phs_number" as $ref | .form_group[].form[].variable_group[].variable[]' \ ${abv,,}_metadata.json | jq -s > ${abv,,}_output.json || exit 255
else echo "Using fallback option for metadata" #jq '.[0] | ("\\" + ."study_phs_number" + "\\") as $studyidpath | '\ #'."study_phs_number" as $ref | .form_group[] | (if .form_group == "N/A" then "" else (.form_group + "\\") end) as $formgroup | '\ #'.form[] | (if .form_name == "N/A" then "" else (.form_name + "\\") end) as $formname | '\ #'.variable_group[] | (if .variable_group_name == "N/A" then "" else (.variable_group_name+ "\\") end) as $vargroup | '\ #'.variable[] | ((.derived_variable_level_data // [{}])[] | .) as $derived_meta | '\ #'{dataset_ref: $ref, '\ #'name: .variable_id, '\ #'display: .variable_name, '\ #'concept_type: "", '\ #'concept_path: ($studyidpath + .variable_id + "\\"), '\ #'metadata: ({ '\ #'description: .variable_description, '\ #'drs_uri: .drs_uri} '\ #'+ $derived_meta) '\ #'}' ${abv,,}_metadata.json | jq -s > ${abv,,}_output.json || exit 255 jq_script=' .[0] | ("\\" + ."study_phs_number" + "\\") as $studyidpath | ."study_phs_number" as $ref | .form_group[] | (if .form_group == "N/A" then "" else (.form_group + "\\") end) as $formgroup | .form[] | (if .form_name == "N/A" then "" else (.form_name + "\\") end) as $formname | .variable_group[] | (if .variable_group_name == "N/A" then "" else (.variable_group_name + "\\") end) as $vargroup | .variable[] | ((.derived_variable_level_data // [{}])[] | .) as $derived_meta | { dataset_ref: $ref, name: .variable_id, display: .variable_name, concept_type: "", concept_path: ($studyidpath + .variable_id + "\\"), metadata: ({ description: .variable_description, drs_uri: .drs_uri } + $derived_meta) } '
jq "$jq_script" "${abv,,}_metadata.json" | jq -s > "${abv,,}_output.json" || exit 255 fi
curl --request PUT --fail --header 'Content-Type: text/json' \ --data @${abv,,}_output.json "${api}/concept/curated?datasetRef=${stdy_id,,}"
